## Barcode Scanning SDK

Al-powered barcode scanning, multiple barcode scanning and augmented reality (AR), label scanning.

[Get a quote](https://www.scandit.com/pricing/plans/#mktoFormContainer_2828_default) [30-day free trial](https://ssl.scandit.com/dashboard/sign-up)

- Flat annual fee or usage-based options.
- **Core Edition:** Single barcode scanning with SparkScan or Barcode Capture.
- **Standard Edition:** Core plus Smart Label Capture, fluorescent barcode scanning, MatrixScan Find, MatrixScan Batch.
- **Advanced Edition:** Standard plus MatrixScan Count, MatrixScan AR, MatrixScan Pick.

## ID Scanning SDK

Extract data from ID cards, visa stickers, passports, drivers’ licenses, and military IDs, and detect fakes.

[Get a quote](https://www.scandit.com/pricing/plans/#mktoFormContainer_2828_default) [30-day free trial](https://ssl.scandit.com/dashboard/sign-up)

- Flat annual fee or usage-based options.
- **Core Edition:** Scan machine readable zones (MRZ) or the barcode on the back of IDs, visas, and passports.
- **Standard Edition:** Core plus expanded document support.
- **Advanced Edition:** Standard plus scanning of all supported ID documents including visual inspection zones (VIZ), mDLs, eIDs.
- **ID Validate Edition:** Fake ID detection.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does Scandit cost?

Scandit offers pricing suitable for businesses of all sizes, from start-ups and SMBs wanting simple barcode scanning on a handful of devices to enterprises operating at global scale. Scandit offers both flat annual fee and usage-based options

### How much does Scandit cost per device?

Scandit has different editions (pricing tiers) for different business needs. Simple plans for small teams, advanced for enterprises — so you pay for your needs, rather than subsidizing someone else's. The lowest tier offers cost-effective AI-powered single barcode scanning or scanning an ID by scanning the barcode on the back or the MRZ (machine readable zone).

### Is Scandit billing monthly or yearly?

Our standard billing frequency is yearly, but we can often accommodate special requests.

### Does Scandit offer a pay-as-you-go model?

Scandit pricing can be tailored to your needs, starting with a small upfront commitment that scales as you grow. Per-scan or per-device billing is often a good choice if you are looking for a pay-as-you-go type model.

### Does Scandit offer a one-time payment option?

Our standard pricing is an annual subscription model based on the scale of your deployment and the features you choose.

### What customer support does Scandit offer?

Dedicated solution consultants, support engineers, and post-sales customer success. Scandit support has a satisfaction rate of >98%.

### Can I get indicative pricing from Scandit to support early-stage planning?

Absolutely! We are happy to help you build your business case.

### What factors affect Scandit pricing?

Scandit pricing is based on the capabilities you need together with the scale of your deployment.

Scandit offers different editions (pricing tiers) for different business needs.

The lowest tier offers cost-effective AI-powered single barcode scanning or scanning an ID by scanning the barcode on the back or the MRZ (machine readable zone).

Higher tiers and enterprise pricing offer multiple barcode scanning and AR (MatrixScan products), label scanning (Smart Label Capture), expanded identity document support, fake ID detection (ID Validate), and retail solutions (Shelf Intelligence and Execution, Planogram and Price Compliance, Expiry Management and Markdowns, and Intelligent In-Store Picking).
